name: serverlens
description: Lightweight multi-server monitor for AI research: GPUs, CPU, memory, disks and quotas over SSH, no remote agent
author: ziyisun85-ops

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language

serverlens.sshConfigPath.description: Path to the SSH config file on this computer. Only your user settings apply (also in Remote-SSH, WSL and container windows); workspace and remote settings are ignored. Not synced by Settings Sync.

serverlens.targets.description: SSH host aliases to monitor. Empty = every concrete Host in the SSH config file.

serverlens.additionalHosts.description: Additional SSH targets (host alias, IP address, or user@host)

serverlens.ignoredHosts.description: List of SSH hosts to ignore

serverlens.connectionReuse.description: Reuse one SSH connection per server (OpenSSH ControlMaster) instead of opening a new one for every refresh. Not available on Windows.

serverlens.connectionIdleSeconds.description: Seconds a shared SSH connection stays open after the last command.

serverlens.autoRefresh.description: Refresh automatically. When off, data updates only on manual refresh.

serverlens.cpuRefreshInterval.description: CPU usage and load refresh interval in seconds.

serverlens.memoryRefreshInterval.description: Memory and swap refresh interval in seconds.

serverlens.diskRefreshInterval.description: Disk capacity and quota refresh interval in seconds.

serverlens.sshTimeout.description: SSH connection timeout in seconds; each remote command is also limited to this time.

serverlens.maxConcurrentHosts.description: Maximum number of SSH hosts queried concurrently

serverlens.pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause automatic refresh while the Monitor view, the Servers tree and every dashboard are hidden. When off, ServerLens collects in the background from VS Code startup.

serverlens.diskWarningThreshold.description: Disk usage (%) shown in yellow. Below this the bar is green.

serverlens.diskCriticalThreshold.description: Disk usage (%) shown in red and used for capacity alerts.

enumDescriptions: Notify once when a disk reaches the critical threshold
Notify at the warning threshold and again at the critical threshold
serverlens.diskAlerts.description: Disk capacity notifications. Each disk notifies once per crossing and can be snoozed or muted.

serverlens.pinnedMounts.markdownDescription: Paths to always show first, e.g. `/data`, `~/projects`, or `gpu-01:/scratch` for one server. A path that is not a mount point shows the filesystem it lives on.

serverlens.hiddenMounts.markdownDescription: Extra mount point patterns to hide, e.g. `/mnt/backup*` or `gpu-01:/var/*`. System mounts such as `/proc`, `/run` and `/snap/*` are hidden already.

serverlens.hiddenFilesystemTypes.markdownDescription: Extra filesystem types to hide, e.g. `nfs4` or `fuse.*`. Pseudo filesystems such as `tmpfs` and `overlay` are hidden already.

serverlens.showAllFilesystems.description: Show every filesystem, including tmpfs, overlay, squashfs and system mounts.

serverlens.showQuota.description: Read personal disk quotas with quota/lfs when the server provides them. Shown separately from free disk space.

enumDescriptions: KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB (base 1024, like df -h and nvidia-smi)
kB, MB, GB, TB (base 1000, like disk vendors)
serverlens.byteUnits.description: Units for memory and disk sizes.

serverlens.storagePaths.markdownDescription: Folders offered by **Analyze Storage**, as `path` or `Label=path`, e.g. `Checkpoints=/data/alice/ckpt`, `~/projects`, `Logs=~/logs`.

serverlens.storageScanDepth.description: How many folder levels Analyze Storage reports (du -d).

serverlens.storageScanTimeout.description: Time limit for one storage scan, in seconds. The scan runs with low CPU and I/O priority and is only started by you.

serverlens.compactLayout.description: Use a dense multi-column layout for servers with many GPUs

serverlens.showPower.description: Show power draw and power limit

serverlens.showFanSpeed.description: Show fan speed when reported by the GPU

serverlens.showProcesses.description: Show GPU processes, owners, PIDs, and memory usage in a collapsible section

serverlens.showHostHealth.description: Show CPU, RAM, the fullest disk, uptime and SSH latency on dashboard server cards.

serverlens.enableSlurmIntegration.description: Automatically associate GPU processes with Slurm jobs when Slurm is available

serverlens.slurmRefreshInterval.description: Seconds between Slurm job metadata refreshes

serverlens.availabilityRequireNoProcesse.description: Require a GPU to have no compute processes before it is considered available

serverlens.availabilityMaxMemoryMiB.description: Maximum used GPU memory in MiB for an available GPU

serverlens.availabilityMaxUtilization.description: Maximum GPU utilization percentage for an available GPU

serverlens.showStatusBar.description: Show free GPUs and full disks in the status bar.

serverlens.enableNotifications.description: Show notifications when a GPU first crosses a warning threshold

serverlens.notificationEvents.description: State transitions that may produce notifications when notifications are enabled

serverlens.notificationCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum time between ServerLens notification batches

serverlens.memoryWarningThreshold.description: Memory usage percentage that triggers warning styling

serverlens.temperatureWarningThreshold.description: Temperature in Celsius that triggers warning styling

serverlens.powerWarningThreshold.description: Power limit percentage that triggers warning styling

serverlens.researchUser.description: Remote username used by the My tasks filter.

serverlens.visibleGpus.description: Visible GPU indices or UUIDs per SSH host. Omitted host = all GPUs; empty list = none. Affects display only.

scripts.dev: npm run compile && node scripts/renderPreview.js && python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1
scripts.preview:build: npm run compile && node scripts/renderPreview.js && node scripts/renderSidebarPreview.js
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: node scripts/checkLocales.js && node ./out/test/manual_test.js && node ./out/test/parsers_test.js && node ./out/test/collect_test.js && node ./out/test/transport_test.js && node ./out/test/scheduler_test.js && node ./out/test/storage_alerts_test.js && node scripts/checkRefresh.js && npm run preview:build && node scripts/checkWebview.js && node scripts/checkSidebar.js && node scripts/checkActivation.js
